name: AfterHoursCouriers Delivery
author: afterhourscouriers

sections.description:
AfterHoursCouriers is a Melbourne based courier company in Victoria, Australia, and our service only caters for Melbourne based deliveries within 100 km of Melbourne.

We only do After Hours Delivery. We don’t do daytime delivery.

There is no need for your shoppers to organise Parcel Post or take time off work, or lose a delivery left on your porch.

What the plugin does:

  • Your shoppers choose a “Delivery or pickup time” (every 30 minutes) and Standard, Urgent or Vital, each with a live price. Delivery is never before the chosen time.
  • As the merchant, you choose when we collect: during business hours (weekdays, before 3pm), after hours (weekdays 5pm to 10:30pm, weekends 9:00am to 5pm), or both.
  • Every delivery is same day. Shoppers are offered the earliest day your settings allow.
  • Send orders to us with one click, or automatically when paid.
  • See the delivery status and download proof of delivery on the order.
  • Charge our price, or add up to 20%.

Requires an AfterHoursCouriers account (7-day terms) and an API key. Deliveries up to 100 km; longer distances on request. Not available on Victorian public holidays.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 9.9 or newer.
  • The WooCommerce block checkout (the default for new shops since late 2023). On the older classic checkout, shoppers don’t see “Delivery or pickup time” and get the earliest available time.
  • An AfterHoursCouriers account on payment terms, and an API key.
  • Make the checkout phone number required (we need the recipient’s phone).
  • Set WordPress Settings > General > Timezone to Melbourne.

External services

This plugin connects to the AfterHoursCouriers merchant API (https://portal.afterhourscouriers.com.au), run by AfterHoursCouriers Service Pty Ltd. It is needed to show delivery options and prices, and to book, track and download proof of delivery for your orders. Every request is sent with your Individual Unique AfterHoursCouriers API key.

  • At checkout, when a shopper enters a delivery address: the plugin fetches available delivery days and times, and sends your collection address, the delivery address, and the parcel weight and size to get prices.
  • When an order is sent to us (by you, or automatically when paid): the plugin sends the collection address and contact, the delivery address, the recipient’s name and phone, the order number, the parcel details, and the chosen delivery option and time.
  • Every hour, and when you click “Refresh status”: the plugin sends the job reference to fetch the delivery status.
  • When you click “Download proof of delivery”: the plugin sends the job reference to fetch the proof-of-delivery PDF.

Terms and conditions: https://www.afterhourscouriers.com.au/terms-and-conditions
Privacy policy: https://www.afterhourscouriers.com.au/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Plugins > Add New > search “AfterHoursCouriers”, then Install and Activate.
  2. To get your API key, email admin@afterhourscouriers.com.au to open an AfterHoursCouriers account. Once your account is approved, we email you your API key.
  3. WooCommerce > AfterHoursCouriers: enter your API key, collection address and contact, and tick when we collect.
  4. WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping: add “AfterHoursCouriers Same Day After Hours Delivery” to your Melbourne shipping zone.
sections.changelog:
0.2.13

  • Security: the order panel’s Send and Refresh status buttons now use nonce-protected POST requests instead of links.
  • Fix: a delivery or pickup time saved on an earlier day no longer blocks checkout; the shopper gets today’s earliest time instead.

0.2.11

  • Security hardening: all order panel output escaped; data returned by the AfterHoursCouriers service is sanitised before it is saved.

0.2.10

  • “Deliver from” is now called “Delivery or pickup time”.

0.2.9

  • “Deliver from” now reads “Select a delivery or pickup time” until a time is chosen.

0.2.8

  • Wording: “Same Day After Hours Delivery” throughout (was “evening delivery”), including weekends.

0.2.7

  • Block checkout: addresses over 100 km now see “Evening delivery isn’t available to this address online. Longer distances are available on request – please contact us.” when no other shipping option is available.

0.2.6

  • Code comment for WordPress coding standards. No change to how the plugin works.

0.2.5

  • Code comment for WordPress coding standards. No change to how the plugin works.

0.2.4

  • Block checkout: the line under each delivery option now says where to choose a later delivery time.

0.2.3

  • readme: External services section (what is sent to AfterHoursCouriers, and when), terms and privacy links. Tested up to WordPress 7.1.

0.2.2

  • Settings form fields are read one by one. No change to how the plugin works.

0.2.1

  • Internal names renamed to the “ahcouriers” prefix. No change to how the plugin works. If updating from 0.2.0: re-enter settings and re-add the shipping method to your zone.

0.2.0

  • Shoppers choose “Deliver from” at checkout (every 30 minutes). Only Standard / Urgent / Vital options that fit the time are shown. Requires WooCommerce 9.9+ and the block checkout.

0.1.1

  • AfterHoursCouriers logo and description on the settings page.
  • “Same-day evening delivery by AfterHoursCouriers, Melbourne.” shown with the delivery options.
  • Internal delivery details hidden on the order screen.

0.1.0

  • First release.
